description: The only GitHub Actions files the gate's `no GitHub Actions workflows` stage allows (ADR-24 as amended by ADR-41, D-086): none since F4 (vazao) deleted the staged Tower runner workflow, which no repository installs (the GitHub repository is archived and forge-events.adapter selects origin). A hosted runner stays one optional, budgeted runner kind (D-087): a workflow for it is named here first, and installed by Daniel, never by a session. The pinned gate reads its own list, so a PR cannot allow its own workflow.
